Starting with AutoJs6 6.8.0, Apache Commons Lang3, Commons IO and Jackson are no longer built in; with this plugin installed and enabled, scripts use the classes of these libraries by their full names as with AutoJs6 6.7.0, and existing scripts need no change
feature: Apache Commons Lang3 3.18.0, Apache Commons IO 2.8.0 and Jackson 2.13.4.2 (core and annotations 2.13.4), the versions AutoJs6 6.7.0 included
The plugin is only a resource package: AutoJs6 loads the classes straight from the plugin, running scripts never starts the plugin process, and the plugin asks for no permission
Apps packaged with AutoJs6 can carry these classes (found by scanning the scripts, or ticked in the list of libraries) and then use them on devices without the plugin
The plugin page shows the version, license and Java package of each library, an example, the NOTICE files and the release history
The plugin page follows the language, night mode and theme color of AutoJs6, and the system when AutoJs6 is not installed or its settings cannot be read
